name: OpenManus
description: Open general-purpose agent in the style of Manus that takes a task typed in the terminal and carries it out with tools.
whatItDoes: Accepts a free-form idea or task from the terminal and works through it autonomously. Offers a single-agent mode, an MCP tool mode and an experimental multi-agent flow that can include a data analysis agent.
howItWorks: A Python agent loop calls an LLM configured in a TOML config file and invokes tools. Separate entry points start the plain agent, the MCP-enabled variant and the multi-agent flow.

requirements.name: Python 3.12
requirements.description: The documented conda environment uses Python 3.12

requirements.name: LLM API key
requirements.description: Model credentials set in the project config file
